issue: Application crashes when uploading files over 10MB
solution: Increase max file upload size in config.yml to 50MB. Add chunked upload mechanism for files larger than 10MB. Implement progress tracking and resume capability.
Increase connection pool size from 10 to 50 in database.properties. Set connection timeout to 60 seconds. Enable connection validation before use.

issue: Users unable to login with SSO
solution: Check SSO certificate expiry date and renew if within 30 days. Verify redirect URLs are whitelisted in identity provider. Clear SSO cache and restart authentication service.

issue: High CPU usage during peak hours
solution: Enable query caching for frequently accessed data. Implement connection pooling with max 100 connections. Add horizontal scaling with load balancer for traffic distribution.
Add retry logic with exponential backoff (3 attempts). Implement circuit breaker pattern. Check and fix database transaction deadlocks. Add proper error logging with stack traces.

issue: Slow page load times on mobile devices
solution: Optimize images by compressing to WebP format. Enable lazy loading for below-fold content. Minify CSS and JavaScript. Implement CDN for static assets. Enable browser caching with 7-day expiry.
Implement event-driven architecture using message queue (RabbitMQ/Kafka). Add idempotency keys to prevent duplicate processing. Enable distributed tracing with correlation IDs.
Profile application using heap dump analysis. Identify and fix unclosed database connections. Implement proper disposal of large objects. Add memory monitoring alerts at 80% threshold.
Verify user has admin role in database user_roles table. Check session token validity and expiration. Clear browser cookies and localStorage. Verify firewall rules allow admin port access.
Check SMTP server connectivity and credentials. Verify email queue is not full (max 10000). Check spam score of email content. Implement retry mechanism for failed sends with 5-minute delay.

issue: File download corrupted for large files
solution: Implement chunked download with Content-Range headers. Add MD5 checksum validation. Enable compression only for text files. Set proper Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.
Rebuild search index using reindex command. Check Elasticsearch cluster health status. Verify index mappings match data structure. Increase search timeout from 30s to 60s.
Increase session timeout from 15 to 60 minutes in session config. Implement sliding expiration. Check for clock skew between servers. Enable persistent sessions with remember-me token.
Verify VPN client version matches server requirements (v2.5+). Check firewall allows UDP 1194 and TCP 443. Regenerate user certificates if expired. Clear VPN cache and reinstall TAP adapter.
Check cron daemon is running using systemctl status cron. Verify cron syntax in crontab. Check job logs in /var/log/cron. Ensure job script has execute permissions (chmod +x).
Archive old data older than 6 months to separate archive database. Enable automatic vacuum for PostgreSQL. Implement data retention policy. Add compression for blob columns.
Clear app cache and data. Update app to latest version from store. Check minimum OS version requirement (iOS 13+/Android 8+). Reinstall app if issue persists. Verify API endpoint is accessible.
Switch from polling to WebSocket connection for real-time updates. Reduce notification batch processing interval from 5 minutes to 30 seconds. Scale notification service horizontally.
Check for foreign key constraints in related tables. Implement soft delete instead of hard delete. Add cascade delete rules. Ensure user has delete permission and owns the account.
Increase memory limit for PDF service from 512MB to 2GB. Add timeout of 5 minutes for large reports. Optimize report queries to reduce data fetching time. Use streaming for large datasets.
Verify phone number format includes country code. Check SMS service provider status and credits. Implement fallback to email 2FA. Allow code validity for 10 minutes instead of 5.
Fix health check endpoint to return 200 status. Increase health check interval from 10s to 30s. Check instance security group allows health check port. Verify application is running on correct port.

Increase backup timeout from 1 hour to 4 hours. Check available disk space (need minimum 50GB free). Implement incremental backup instead of full backup. Verify backup user has sufficient permissions.
Check widget API endpoints are responding with 200 status. Clear browser cache and reload. Verify user permissions for each widget. Increase API timeout from 5s to 15s. Check CORS headers.

Verify payment gateway API credentials are current. Check SSL certificate validity. Implement retry logic for transient failures (3 attempts). Add detailed error logging. Test in sandbox environment first.
